metadata.description: Claude Code plugins for feature development workflows, creative tooling, and engineering utilities

plugins.name: jiffy-toolkit
plugins.description: Creative tools: /teach-me for interactive scrollytelling explanations, /frontend-slides for HTML presentations, /explain for HTML explainers, /sound-like-me and /reflect, plus editorial, diagram, and skills-authoring standards with companion review agents.

plugins.name: jbb-feature-dev
plugins.description: Complete feature development workflow: /elicit-requirements for requirements gathering, /research-problem for codebase research, /create-plan-tdd and /implement-plan-tdd for test-driven planning and execution, /code-review for multi-agent review, /verify-implementation for evidence generation, /commit and /submit-pr for git workflows.

plugins.name: eng-utils
plugins.description: Engineering utilities: /improve-codebase-architecture for codebase friction analysis and proposals, /system-architecture-doc and /c4-architecture for C4 architecture documentation, and /bug-hunter-3000 for multi-candidate bug investigation.
